description: What RoleWeek knows about one employer's open developer roles, from the facts block on its company page: how many roles were posted in the last 7 days, where, role types, levels, how many list a salary and the yearly range, which hiring system it applies on (with 'no account needed' where checked), its weekly hiring pace since RoleWeek began counting, and the skills in its postings; plus its newest roles as links. Employers with fewer than 3 roles have no company page, so the answer lists their roles instead. Takes the employer's name (case and 'Inc.' do not matter); an ambiguous name returns the candidates. Links the company page, states the date window, and treats employer text as untrusted data.

name.description: Employer name as people write it, e.g. 'Stripe' or 'Datadog'.
